'''Counter Shield''' (Japanese: '''カウンターシールド''' ''Counter Shield'') is a tactic developed by [[Ash Ketchum]] in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''. Ash developed this technique while trying to find a way to prevent [[Fantina]]'s {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} from making his Pokémon {{status|sleep}} with {{m|Hypnosis}}. It was eventually used for both offensive and defensive purposes. Ash took inspiration from the [[Contest Battle]] between {{an|Dawn}} and [[Lila]] in the {{to|Celestic}} {{pkmn|Contest}} in ''[[DP095|Battling The Generation Gap!]]'' to develop this technique. In ''[[DP102|Shield with a Twist!]]'', Ash used it in his [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} with Fantina. Amazed with the method, Fantina named it the ''Counter Shield''. It eventually helped Ash with his battle, earning him the {{badge|Relic}}. In ''[[DP132|Evolving Strategies!]]'', it was used again by [[Ash's Pikachu]], {{AP|Buizel}}, and {{AP|Monferno|Infernape}} against [[Paul]]'s Pokémon. This time, however, all three Pokémon were defeated, and Paul didn't seem all that impressed with the technique. However, he later used this technique with his {{p|Gastrodon}}'s {{m|Muddy Water}} in ''[[DP186|Familiarity Breeds Strategy!]]'' and [[Paul's Electivire|his Electivire's]] {{m|Thunder}} in ''[[DP188|Battling a Thaw in Relations!]]'', where Buizel used the technique once again. In ''[[BW086|Piplup, Pansage, and a Meeting of the Times!]]'', it was used by [[Dawn's Piplup]] to counter [[Cilan's Pansage]]'s {{m|Rock Tomb}} attack. In ''[[SM043|When Regions Collide!]]'', Brock commanded his Geodude and Steelix to use {{m|Gyro Ball}} to deflect attacks, and mentioned that "a certain challenger of his" taught him to use a Pokémon's attack as a means of defense. In ''[[JN123|Bewitch, Battle, and Bewilder!]]'', Ash used it for the first time since [[Sinnoh]] during his battle against {{an|Cynthia}}. Pikachu used Thunderbolt to counter {{p|Spiritomb}}'s {{m|Hypnosis}}. In ''[[JN129|A Flood of Torrential Gains!]]'', {{an|Leon}} instructed his {{p|Inteleon}} to use a Counter Shield of his own, having seen the technique in the [[JN123|last semifinals battle]]. ==Methods== ===Pikachu=== {{countershield|electric|Ash Pikachu Counter Shield|Ash's Pikachu|DP102|ep=Shield with a Twist!|{{mcolor|Thunderbolt|{{electric color dark}}}}|Pikachu spins on his back while using Thunderbolt to form an electric barrier in order to protect himself from the opponent's attacks.}} ===Monferno=== {{countershield|fire|Ash Monferno Counter Shield|Ash's Monferno|n=Ash's Chimchar/Monferno|DP102|ep=Shield with a Twist!|{{mcolor|Flamethrower|{{fire color dark}}}} and {{mcolor|Flame Wheel|{{fire color dark}}}}|Chimchar/Monferno uses Flamethrower while using Flame Wheel to create flame whips that prevent foes from getting closer while also hitting the opponent.}} ===Buizel=== {{countershield|water|Ash Buizel Counter Shield|Ash's Buizel|DP102|ep=Shield with a Twist!|{{mcolor|Aqua Jet|{{water color dark}}}} or {{mcolor|Water Gun|{{water color dark}}}}|Buizel spins on his back while using Aqua Jet to create a water tornado or Water Gun to create water whips in order to protect himself from the opponent's attacks.}} ===Drifblim=== {{countershield|ghost|Fantina Drifblim Counter Shield|Fantina's Drifblim|DP102|ep=Shield with a Twist!|{{mcolor|Will-O-Wisp|{{ghost color dark}}}} and {{mcolor|Psychic|{{ghost color dark}}}}|Drifblim uses Will-O-Wisp to surround its body in fire wisps. opponent.}} ==Trivia== * Pikachu and Buizel's Counter Shields are similar to the way [[Dawn's Ambipom]] used {{m|Swift}} for her [[appeal]] in the [[Solaceon Town]] [[Pokémon Contest]] in ''[[DP061|Team Shocker!]]''. * Piplup's Counter Shield is similar to the technique he perfected in ''[[DP007|Like It or Lup It!]]'' while {{pkmn|training}} for the {{ci|Jubilife}} Contest. * During her {{pkmn|battle}} against [[Conway]] in ''[[DP088|Camping It Up!]]'', {{an|Dawn}} commanded the {{p|Grimer}} she {{pkmn2|rental|borrowed}} from the [[Pokémon Summer Academy]] to use {{m|Poison Gas}} while spinning to surround its body with smoke in order to avoid the opponent's attacks. This was shown to work the same way as the Counter Shield but was used before the tactic was introduced to the series. * During Ash's [[JN025|battle]] against {{an|Korrina}} during the [[World Coronation Series]], his {{AP|Dragonite}} used {{m|Dragon Dance}} in a way to not only boost its attack power and speed, but also deflect the opponent's physical attacks, resulting in a counter reminiscent to Counter Shield. This technique is used again in ''[[JN109|Aim For The Eight!]]'', during Ash's entrance battle against [[Raihan]], and in ''[[JN130|Toying With Your Motions!]]'', during the finals of the [[Masters Eight Tournament]]. ** In ''[[JN065|Thrash of the Titans!]]'', Dragonite uses a similar style of counter by using {{m|Hurricane}} around itself to deflect a {{m|Psycho Cut}} and a {{m|Dragon Pulse}} from [[Iris's Haxorus]]. * Of all the characters that have taught their Pokémon to use Counter Shield, {{an|Leon}} is the only one that did not appear in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''. ==In other languages== {{Langtable|color={{arceus color}}|bordercolor={{arceus color light}} |zh_cmn=返拳防護罩 ''Fǎnquán Fánghùzhào'' |cs=Protištít ([[DP102]], [[JN123]]-present)
